claim: On the Kuwait Visa portal, a Bangladeshi with no valid US, UK or Schengen visa or residence permit and no GCC residence permit is told 'Applicant is not eligible for applying e-visa' for a tourist visa (9 November 2026)
quote: Do you have: Others Applicant is not eligible for applying e-visa.
field: open to Bangladeshis without US/UK/Schengen/GCC visa or permit

claim: The tourist-visa routes the portal offers a Bangladeshi: a valid US, UK or Schengen tourist visa, a valid US, UK or Schengen residence permit, or a valid GCC residence permit
quote: US, UK, or Schengen valid tourist visa holder | US, UK, or Schengen valid residence permit | GCC valid residence permit | Others

claim: On the Kuwait Visa portal, Bangladesh nationality is eligible to apply online for a family visit visa (9 November 2026)
quote: Select Nationality: Bangladesh You are eligible for applying online e-visa.

claim: A family visit visa needs a family member living in Kuwait to submit the request
quote: This visa usually requires a family member residing in the host country to submit a request to visit their family members

claim: Family visit visa (portal instructions): passport valid at least 6 months, entry permit valid 30 days from issue, stay no more than 90 days from entry, single entry
quote: Family Visit Visa Passport validity: No less than 6 months Entry permit validity: 30 days from the date of issuance Stay duration: No more than 90 days from the date of entry Number of entries: Single entry

claim: Tourist visa (portal instructions): passport valid at least 6 months, entry permit valid 30 days, stay no more than 90 days, single entry
quote: Tourism Visa Passport validity: No less than 6 months Entry permit validity: 30 days from the date of issuance Stay duration: No more than 90 days from the date of entry

claim: Business visit visa (portal instructions): entry permit valid 30 days, stay no more than 30 days from entry, single entry
quote: Business Visa Passport validity: No less than 6 months Entry permit validity: 30 days from the date of issuance Stay duration: No more than 30 days from the date of entry

claim: Government visit visa (portal instructions): stay no more than 90 days from entry, single entry
quote: Government Visa Passport validity: No less than 6 months Entry permit validity: 30 days from the date of issuance Stay duration: No more than 90 days from the date of entry

claim: Every visit visa holder is barred from working and must leave when the visit period ends
quote: The visa holder is prohibited from working and must leave the country upon the expiration of the visit period

claim: A business visit needs a Kuwaiti company to apply, with proof of the business purpose
quote: A local company is required to apply for a business visit with proof of the business purpose of the visit

claim: The portal reports about 95,000 tourist, 74,000 family, 25,000 business and 6,000 government visit visas issued in 2025
quote: Tourist Visa 95 Thousand Visas issued in 2025

claim: Family visit visas issued in 2025: about 74,000
quote: Family Visa 74 Thousand Visas issued in 2025

claim: Application steps on the portal: create an account, complete the profile, submit the visa application, track updates
quote: Create your account
